title: Apparel returns 1.6× category benchmark — 'runs small' cluster

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

checks.text: Hygiene and hazmat units route to destroy with a record — lock satisfied.
Every grade routes at or above its value floor.
Return-less threshold sits under the refurbish floor.
Supplier CAPA carries a 30-day deadline and a $2.8K chargeback — above the $250 floor.

proposal.recommendation_detail: 6 prevention fixes plus the disposition rules save +$21.4K a quarter — +$16.6K by preventing returns and +$4.8K by routing the ones that still happen. The fit cohort is projected to fall from 18.4% to 9.4%, read on a lag rather than immediately.

next_actions.title: Approve all 6 fixes
next_actions.note: Publishes content, sends the CAPA notice and updates the RMA rules.

next_actions.title: Content fixes only
next_actions.note: Ship the page work now, hold packaging and the supplier CAPA for review.

next_actions.title: Disposition rules only
next_actions.note: Change routing and the return-less rule without touching any listing.

next_actions.title: Send back to Analyze
next_actions.note: Reject with a note. Realify re-clusters with your correction.

slate.title: Republish size charts from production measurements
slate.note: Six styles remeasured off the production run, not the sample. Adds a per-style fit note.

slate.title: Surface fit reviews above the fold
slate.note: Pin the three most-helpful fit reviews and a “runs small — size up” badge on the 18 SKUs.

slate.title: Divider and 32ECT carton for mixed orders
slate.note: $0.34 per order on roughly 3,400 mixed orders a quarter. Cuts the 4.1× damage multiple.

slate.title: Open supplier CAPA on lots 4412–4419
slate.note: Thread weight below spec. 30-day corrective deadline, $2.8K chargeback on the affected lot.

slate.title: Colour-correct two colourways and add a swatch macro
slate.note: Reshoot is not needed — the raw files white-balance correctly. Adds a macro to the gallery.

slate.title: Suppress M and L on the two worst styles until the fix ships
slate.note: Those two size pairs return at 28% and 24%. Two weeks of suppression costs less than the returns.
